image_description: A large, elongated soap bubble floats in the upper right foreground, displaying vibrant iridescent colors (rainbow spectrum) against a desaturated, black-and-white urban street background. The background features a graffiti-covered utility pole, pedestrians, and storefronts. There is visible text on the pole and potentially at the bottom of the image.
